findings.evidence: `Line.lean:7` imports `Poincare.Betweenness`, which itself imports `Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Segment`; the listed declarations use only `unitDiscMoebiusIsometryEquiv`, `radialGeodesic`, its isometry/injectivity API, and basic metric facts already available from `Poincare.Geodesic`.
findings.fix: Move these declarations to `Poincare/Geodesic.lean`; keep classification and incidence results that require `existsUnique_eq_radialGeodesic` in `Line.lean`.
findings.issue: `geodesicLine` and its elementary API (lines 88–130 and `geodesicLine_injective` at line 157) depend only on the existing geodesic/isometry layer, but live in a file that publicly imports the later `Betweenness` theory.

summary: The foundational arbitrary-point geodesic API is placed after the later betweenness theory, forcing downstream users to import unrelated convex/betweenness material.
